test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What role did Small-Scale Industries (SSIS) play in the 6th Five-Year Plan's trade strategy?

options.text: They were discouraged in favor of large-scale units
They were expected to focus only on local markets
They were promoted as key exporters and employment generators
They were merged with public sector units

solution:
The correct answer is __**They were promoted as key exporters and employment generators.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Small-Scale Industries (SSIs)** played a vital role in the **6th Five-Year Plan (1980–1985)**, focusing on promoting exports and generating employment in India.
 
• The strategy aimed to **maximize the utilization of resources** by encouraging SSIs to produce goods for export markets, thereby increasing India's foreign exchange earnings.
 
• SSIs were identified as **key contributors to employment generation** due to their labor-intensive nature, providing jobs to millions, particularly in rural and semi-urban areas.
 
• The government introduced various **financial incentives**, subsidies, and technical support to enhance the competitiveness of SSIs in international markets.
 
• There was a significant emphasis on **diversifying production** in SSIs, targeting sectors like textiles, handicrafts, leather goods, and other traditional industries with export potential.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Role of Small-Scale Industries in Economic Development:**

 
 
• SSIs are considered the backbone of India's economy due to their **contribution to GDP**, employment, and exports.
 
• They are vital for **regional development**, as they operate in remote and underdeveloped areas, promoting balanced economic growth.
 
• SSIs utilize **local resources** and skills, thereby reducing dependence on large-scale industrial units.
 
• Examples of SSI products include **handicrafts, garments, processed foods, and leather goods**, many of which are exported globally.
 
 
 
• **Government Schemes to Support SSIs:**
 
 
• **Integrated Development of Small Scale Industries:** Focused on providing financial and technical assistance to SSIs.
 
• **Export Promotion Capital Goods Scheme:** Allowed SSIs to import machinery at reduced duties to improve production quality for exports.
 
• **Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme:** Provided subsidies for upgrading SSI technology.
 
 
 
• **Challenges Faced by SSIs:**
 
 
• **Lack of infrastructure:** Many SSIs struggle with inadequate facilities, affecting production and efficiency.
 
• **Limited access to credit:** Despite government initiatives, SSIs often face difficulties obtaining loans at reasonable interest rates.
 
• **Global competition:** SSIs face stiff competition from cheaper imports and technologically advanced products from other countries.
 
 
 
• **Employment Generation:**
 
 
• SSIs are highly **labor-intensive**, employing a significant portion of the workforce in rural and urban areas.
 
• They provide employment opportunities in **traditional sectors**, promoting the preservation of indigenous skills and crafts.
 
• According to estimates, SSIs contribute to over **40% of India's total employment** in the industrial sector.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **6th Five-Year Plan (1980–1985):**

 
 
• Focused on **economic modernization** and achieving self-reliance.
 
• Emphasized the **promotion of SSIs** as part of an export-oriented strategy.
 
• Targeted sectors with high export potential, such as textiles, leather goods, and handicrafts.
 
 
 
• **Export Contribution of SSIs:**
 
 
• SSIs contribute significantly to India's exports, accounting for approximately **45-50%** of total exports.
 
• Products like **handicrafts, gems, and jewelry** are among the major export items from SSIs.
 
 
 
• **Policy Support:**
 
 
• Government initiatives like **tax exemptions, subsidies, and technical support** have been crucial in boosting SSI performance.
 
• Special focus on promoting SSIs in **rural and backward areas** to ensure balanced economic growth.
